text: The "Create TODO List" command has no apiEndpoint anywhere in its model — checked slice.json, the raw COMMAND node meta (id 4f8b8d06-2740-46ec-a8bd-9b5b58957dca), and even the sibling "TODO Lists" READMODEL for comparison (same gap there, no apiEndpoint/table). build-state-change's Step 1 and this stack's src/lib/api.ts both require the command's POST path to be read verbatim from slice.json — never guessed or invented. Please add an apiEndpoint (e.g. a REST path, or a Supabase RPC/table name) to the "Create TODO List" command on the board so postCommand has a real destination to call.
